jobs.occupation: Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) Specialist (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the department Data Engineering in Hamburg, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) Specialist (d/f/m)

As an MBSE Specialist, you will shape a key part of our Digital Transformation. This transformation aims to fundamentally revolutionize the development of future aircraft models. As the operational lead for MBSE, you are responsible for the practical implementation and scaling of Model-Based Systems Engineering within specific flagship projects. In doing so, you align consistently with the Engineering ​​Digital Agenda and drive the transformation process - moving from digitalization to AI-driven corporate transformation. Your focus lies on establishing robust data models to serve as a "single source of truth" and using them as a foundation to automate engineering system models.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours (min. 28 hours / week) and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Guide the introduction of MBSE as a development method for complex airframe projects.
- Co-create the MBSE Framework (method, language, tools) as a platform architecture for a distributed development environment in alignment with our Digital Agenda.
- Manage the technical MBSE environment and extend it to other product development activities.
- Integrate the MBSE method into existing business processes across the value chain.
- Evaluate and advance modeling methods and tools in alignment with corporate development requirements and partners.
- Provide practical support to project teams during system analysis, requirement definition, and system architecture modeling.
- Coordinate and integrate internal/external development partners and suppliers.
- Mentor and inspire team members through MBSE training and knowledge sharing.

Desired skills and qualifications

- University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or an equivalent qualification.
- Experience with relevant IT systems / digital twins and applications which can be linked in the frame of MBSE (e.g. CAPELLA, DOORS, CAMEO System Modeller, SYSML, UML, RCT, Web APIs).
- Solid understanding of requirements management, system modeling, system integration, V&V, configuration management, and software development (e.g. Python, C#, JavaScript).
- A passion for mastering MBSE and co-creating its successful implementation.
- High interest in MBSE standards (see following standards for your reference: ISO/IEC 15288, ISO12207, ARP 4754A).
- Experience defining and handling engineering and business processes.
- Strong teamwork, communication, organizational skills and a high capacity for abstract thinking.
- Negotiation-level proficiency in English open-mindedness regarding occasional travel.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

To apply, send us your CV along with a cover letter that tells us what inspires your enthusiasm for MBSE.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

AGGP2027 Graduate Engineering Planning & Data Manager

Start date - October 2027

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities. We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.

During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey, covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.

Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.

Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs. Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.

Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.

If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

As part of your application, PLEASE ATTACH A CV & COVER LETTER

What you will be doing

You will be on a development pathway to prepare you to be an Engineering Planning & Data Manager and can expect to be involved in the following:

- Plan and steer engineering customization activities within challenging projects to implement specific airline requests
- Performing Data Analytics tasks on the Airbus internal platform Skywise and other environments
- Contribute in shaping the future way of working while supporting digitalisation initiatives
- Unique possibility to get to know the aircraft customization from early definition up to certification and delivery, combining theory (processes and project management) and practice (manufacturing and delivery)
- gaining an insight in all the different areas involved in delivering a customised product with a focus on Cabin & Cargo

Your development pathway will include a minimum of one rotation on a different mission.

At the end of the 2 year development programme you will be fully equipped to be a key player as Engineering Planning & Data Manager.

What we look for

To be a successful applicant to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme, you will need to demonstrate you have:

- A degree level or equivalent within a relevant field of study
- Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of engineering preferable with knowledge in data science or analytics
- Degree required: Bachelor degree
- Strong verbal and written communication in our business language (English)
- A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation
- The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your Development.
- Specific experience or interests: project management, strong communication skills, interested in digital trends and data oriented

Please note, we love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. We encourage you to take time to decide which of our exciting opportunities is right for you and then submit an application that best represents you, your skills and experience in connection with the role you have selected.

jobs.description:
Group Account Manager HPC, B&W (d/w/m)

JOB PURPOSE

As Group Account Manager, you will lead the commercial strategy and development of the HPC and B&W categories across strategically important customers. You will be responsible for driving sustainable growth, shaping long-term customer partnerships and leading a high-performing Key Account Management team to deliver ambitious business results.
Working cross-functionally and internationally, you will translate market opportunities, shopper insights and customer needs into winning growth strategies that create value for both our customers and Unilever. You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.

Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.

This role is temporary from September 2026 until February 2027 (total of 6 months)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop, deploy and monitor the HPC, B&W customer and omni-channel strategy with 3 years Joint Business Planning scope for assigned top accounts.
• Lead, inspire and develop an experienced and diverse Key Account Management Team and get the maximum out of it by over-achieving commercial business targets (top-/bottomline, shares).
• Influence key stakeholders internally/externally to unlock full customer growth potential and get the required support, cross-functionally and in international teams.
• Drive fact-based decision making by leveraging market, customer and shopper insights to optimize investments, allocate resources and unlock growth opportunities.
• Internal/external heavyweight stakeholder management by building profound business partnerships based on innovative Thought- & Action-Leadership model.
• Forsee future trends and convert into solid strategies and tactics with a focus on efficient deployment across all types of stakeholders.
• Build, deploy and monitor the annual negotiation process. Use Integrated Business Planning process to unlock your internal/external stakeholder’s interests.
• Step-up and inspire Commercial Team’s as vibrant and agile CBD influencer.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• University degree in Business Management, Sales, Marketing
• Min. 3-5 years Commercial and CD frontline experience (e.g. Senior Key Account Manager, Senior CSP Manager) in Germany; FMCG preferred
• Min. 2 years Category Strategy & Planning or Brand Building management experience
• H&B Channel experience, including international sales experience
• Profound and certified Category Management skills
• Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop high-performing teams in a dynamic and fast-changing environment.
• Fluent English and German skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong influencing skills: You know how to secure resources from cross-functional Teams (e.g. Category Management, Shopper Marketing, Category Strategy & Planning, Brand Building, Consumer Market Insights) to identify & drive key initiatives and growth opportunities.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills: You show passion to drive data-based decisions. You are used analyzing and interpreting data (e.g. YouGov) and come up with solutions and ideas rather than indicating only issues.
• Collaboration skills: You know how to envision/engage people on different functions and levels in an international environment.
• Negotiation skills: You take a leading role in preparing, running the annual negotiations. Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills with a proven ability to deliver mutually beneficial business outcomes.
• eCommerce: You learn, develop and deploy state-of-the-art knowledge and skills to develop business seamlessly, with clear omni-channel mindset.

ARE YOU INTERESTED?

Please apply via this portal as e-mail applications will not be processed. By applying to this role, you are confirming that you have informed your Line Manager and that you are at a point in your career with Unilever where it is appropriate for you to be applying for other positions.   

We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment journey. Should you require additional information or reasonable adjustments to allow you to present your best self during this process, please contact your Talent Partner.

jobs.occupation: Sustainability Specialist (m/w/d) (Umwelt-Auditor/in)
jobs.description:
ENERCON GmbH
We are seeking a highly motivated Sustainability Specialist to join our team: This position will play a pivotal role in driving various sustainability programs across our worldwide operations, supporting the further development of our sustainability strategy and communicating our sustainability initiatives and successes.
The ideal candidate will have a thorough understanding of the current sustainability landscape, a strong interest for communication and working collaboratively on sustainability programs with different departments - but above all - be passionate about all aspects of sustainability.
Interested in actively shaping the sustainability journey, all while working for the global energy transition? We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Your responsibilities:

- Actively contribute to the implementation, further development and anchoring of ENERCON's company-wide sustainability strategy and related roadmaps, including the identification of gaps, priorities and next steps
- Drive the development of customer-oriented sustainability solutions and value propositions in close collaboration with relevant functions
- Coordinate cross-functional and international working groups to support the implementation, integration and tracking of sustainability initiatives, including circularity initiatives
- Monitor and analyze sustainability-related regulations, market trends, competitor activities and stakeholder expectations to derive actionable recommendations for ENERCON's sustainability strategy, roadmaps and reporting
- Manage the collection, consolidation and quality assurance of selected sustainability steering KPIs for internal steering, decision making and performance tracking
- Lead selected sustainability communications, including the annual sustainability highlight report, and contribute to communication planning for internal and external target groups in close coordination with Corporate Communications and relevant stakeholders

Your qualifications:

- Graduate degree in sustainability or business administration, preferably in the field of circularity, energy, climate change or environment and relevant professional experience in the field of energy, circularity, communication, auditing or consulting
- 3+ years of experience in a position in sustainability
- Strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to identify gaps, derive priorities and translate sustainability topics into actionable initiatives
- Excellent understanding of sustainability standards, reporting frameworks and regulatory developments, such as CSRD, Circular Economy Act, etc.
- Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage deadlines and lead cross-functional initiatives in a collaborative environment
- Clear communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to engage stakeholders at different levels and present complex sustainability topics in an accessible way
- Preferably international work experience and intercultural awareness
- Highly articulate with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel to the headquarters in Northern Germany

jobs.occupation: R-1187720 Project Management Office (d/f/m) Foods Germany (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Earlier this year (March 2026), Unilever announced an agreement to separate our Foods business. Our Foods business, including brands such as Hellmann's and Knorr, will join forces with McCormick to become a global flavour leader, with leading positions across spices, seasonings, condiments and complementary food categories, supported by a strong retail and food service platform. McCormick has 135+ years of heritage, a presence in 150+ countries and territories, and a portfolio of trusted brands. The transaction remains subject to consultation, regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions with a targeted deal close of mid-2027.

JOB PURPOSE

This role exists to act as a key link between global, regional, and local stakeholders, providing broad cross-functional exposure and fostering collaboration across Unilever and the future separated Foods business.

You’ll be part of a team that believes in doing work that matters — for people and the planet.

Because here, we don’t just hire for jobs. We invite you to be part of something bigger.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead and coordinate a major business transformation initiative in Germany.
- Track milestones, manage dependencies, and resolve roadblocks.

Lead Commissioning Manager (w/m/d) Mechanical

Komm Sie jetzt ins Team von Sygna!

Sygna is a leading international company in the field of commissioning
and technical project management. We implement high-performance
building solutions for data centers, office buildings, gigafactories,
pharmaceutical laboratories, and historic buildings—from concept to
successful handover.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Lead Commissioning Manager
(m/f/d) Mechanical in Frankfurt to start as soon as possible.

commissioning management of building services

design to completion

* Close and proactive communication with our clients throughout all
project phases

equipment, materials)

* Implementation and oversight of quality assurance processes to
ensure that all commissioning activities and milestones meet
client expectations

* Structured documentation and reporting of commissioning activities

* Preparation and execution of the final acceptance inspection and
handover to the facility management teams

electrical engineering, utility engineering, mechanical
engineering, building services engineering, or similar)

* Several years of professional experience in commissioning,
technical project management, or a comparable field

* Extensive technical expertise and very good knowledge of
commissioning methods and building services engineering

* Strong customer and service orientation, as well as excellent
communication skills
